page.title: Sotogrande Polo Weekend: Yacht Charter for the Ultimate VIP Experience

data.meta_description: Experience the Sotogrande polo weekend in style with a luxury yacht charter from Marbella. Sail from Puerto Banús, moor at the club, and enjoy VIP hospitality. Book your boat today.
data.summary: Combine the world-class Sotogrande polo weekend with a luxury yacht charter from Marbella. Depart Puerto Banús, moor at the polo club, and enjoy VIP treatment with our fleet of motor yachts and catamarans.

faq.q: How long does it take to sail from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande?
faq.a: The distance is about 12 nautical miles. With our motor yachts, you can expect a cruise time of 30–40 minutes, depending on sea conditions. It’s a smooth, scenic journey along the Costa del Sol.

faq.q: Can I moor my yacht at the Sotogrande Marina during the polo weekend?
faq.a: Yes, the Sotogrande Marina is a full-service marina with visitor berths. We recommend booking your berth in advance during the polo season, as demand is high. Our team can assist with arrangements.

faq.q: What boats are best for a group attending the polo weekend?
faq.a: For groups up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offer ample deck space and luxury. For smaller parties, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) is a stylish choice.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Tier B boats also include a free jet ski.

faq.q: Can I watch the polo matches from the boat?
faq.a: The polo fields are inland, so you cannot watch from the boat. However, you can moor at the marina and walk to the club (5–10 min). Many guests enjoy the cruise as a prelude to the match and a relaxing return.

faq.q: Is it possible to combine the polo weekend with other activities?
faq.a: Absolutely. After the match, cruise back to Puerto Banús for dinner at a beachfront restaurant, or anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim. You can also extend the charter to include sunset views of La Concha mountain.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht for the Sotogrande polo weekend?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and availability on our full fleet. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance during the polo season. Provide your group size and preferred date, and we’ll tailor a proposal.

data.body_html:
The Sotogrande polo weekend is one of the most prestigious social events on the Costa del Sol, drawing an international crowd of sports enthusiasts and luxury seekers. Combining world-class polo matches with the glamour of a superyacht charter creates an unforgettable VIP experience. Depart from Puerto Banús, cruise the 12 nautical miles to Sotogrande in under 40 minutes, and moor your private yacht at the marina steps from the club. With our fleet of motor yachts and catamarans, you can enjoy the best of both worlds: a stylish sea journey and front-row access to the polo action.

Why Charter a Yacht for the Sotogrande Polo Weekend?

The Sotogrande polo weekend is more than a sporting event—it’s a social fixture. A private yacht charter elevates the experience by adding exclusivity, comfort, and flexibility. Instead of battling traffic on the coastal road, you glide across the Mediterranean with a glass of cava in hand. Your yacht becomes a floating VIP lounge, perfect for pre-match aperitifs or post-match celebrations. Mooring at the Sotogrande Marina places you minutes from the polo fields, while the return journey offers sunset views of the Sierra Blanca and La Concha mountain.

Our Fleet: The Perfect Boats for the Occasion

We offer a range of yachts suitable for groups of 5 to 12 guests. For a stylish day out, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) is a popular choice at €749 for two hours or €2,299 for a full day (8 hours). If you want to make a statement, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for a minimum of four hours includes a free jet ski. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers panoramic views from its flybridge, ideal for watching the coastline. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA.

Itinerary: Marbella to Sotogrande and Back

A typical polo weekend charter begins at Puerto Banús. Board your yacht at 14:00, enjoy welcome drinks, and cruise east along the coast. Pass the Golden Mile, Marbella Marina, and Cabopino before arriving at Sotogrande Marina around 14:45. Walk to the polo club (5–10 minutes) for the 16:00 match. After the match, return to the yacht for a sunset cruise back to Puerto Banús, with an optional swim stop at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Dinner reservations at a Puerto Banús restaurant can be arranged.

What to Expect: The Polo Weekend Experience

The Sotogrande polo weekend typically features high-goal matches with international players. The atmosphere is elegant yet relaxed: spectators dress in smart casual or summer whites, and the club offers hospitality tents, champagne bars, and fine dining. With a yacht charter, you have the added benefit of a private space to retreat to between chukkas. The marina is a short walk, so you can return to the boat for refreshments or a quiet moment before the next match.

Book Your Sotogrande Polo Weekend Yacht Charter

To secure your preferred yacht for the Sotogrande polo weekend, contact us via WhatsApp. Provide your group size, preferred date, and any special requests. We recommend booking at least three weeks in advance during the July–August season. Our team will confirm availability, arrange mooring at Sotogrande Marina, and tailor the itinerary to your needs. Whether you choose the compact Azimut 39 or the majestic Mangusta 80, you’re guaranteed a VIP experience on the water.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to sail from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande?

The distance is about 12 nautical miles. With our motor yachts, you can expect a cruise time of 30–40 minutes, depending on sea conditions. It’s a smooth, scenic journey along the Costa del Sol.

Can I moor my yacht at the Sotogrande Marina during the polo weekend?

Yes, the Sotogrande Marina is a full-service marina with visitor berths. We recommend booking your berth in advance during the polo season, as demand is high. Our team can assist with arrangements.

What boats are best for a group attending the polo weekend?

For groups up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offer ample deck space and luxury. For smaller parties, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) is a stylish choice.

What is included in the charter price?

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Tier B boats also include a free jet ski.

Can I watch the polo matches from the boat?

The polo fields are inland, so you cannot watch from the boat. However, you can moor at the marina and walk to the club (5–10 min). Many guests enjoy the cruise as a prelude to the match and a relaxing return.

Is it possible to combine the polo weekend with other activities?

Absolutely. After the match, cruise back to Puerto Banús for dinner at a beachfront restaurant, or anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim. You can also extend the charter to include sunset views of La Concha mountain.

How do I book a yacht for the Sotogrande polo weekend?

Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and availability on our full fleet. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance during the polo season. Provide your group size and preferred date, and we’ll tailor a proposal.
